Specification: This module specifies a very small state machine centered around a recursively defined factorial operator. The state consists of a single variable f, which is initialized to Fact(4) and updated in the next-state action to Fact(7). The comments indicate that the purpose of the specification is to test whether an unrolling-based tool reports that UNROLL_TIMES_Fact is missing while a default unroll value UNROLL_DEFAULT_Fact is defined; the module also states a simple invariant that f is at least 1.
IfThenElse: IF n <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE n * Fact(n - 1)
